Selected portfolio

Projects.

A selection from more than 100 projects managed or supervised, with a total portfolio exceeding €50 million.

Marine Biodiversity Conservation Center “Boka Aquarium” ( MonteAqua )

December 2017 - December 2020

As project manager, I am securing successful implementation of main project activities: 

  • Setting up Marine Biodiversity Conservation Center “Boka Aquarium” in the Institute of Marine Biology in Kotor
  • Setting up freshwater “Skadar Aquarium” in National Park “Skadar lake”
  • Development of communication platform for stakeholders’ participation in water biodiversity conservation
  • Organizing capacity building workshops
  • Organization of International conference “Adriatic Biodiversity Protection” in 2019.

Sustainable Use of Transboundary Water Resources and Water Security Management (WATER SUM)

Januar 2014 - September 2016

As Project Director, I provided overall quality control of the project, supervision of the Project Manager and team members, monitoring of the progress of the project activities and coordination of information flow between the project team, beneficiaries and the donor. Water SUM project addresses water-related challenges and promotes regional cooperation in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) through two project components: Water Resources Management Good Practices and Knowledge Transfer (WATER POrT); and Water Security in Local Communities (WaSe). 

Setting up Environmental Management Center (EMC) in Serbia

October 2010 – May 2013

I edited International Science Conference “Reporting for Sustainability” proceedings. Besides that publication, the main EMC project outputs are the established Environmental Management Center within Serbian Agency for Environmental Protection (SEPA) including necessary computer hardware and software, training of personnel, introducing efficient and sound routines and practices. EMC project worked directly with governmental institutions and 10 selected large industrial client-partners from various industrial sectors across Serbia: petrochemical industry, agricultural sector, railways, rubber manufacturing, coal production and processing, steel production and processing, copper mining and smelting, as well as public utility providing district heating.

Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services for Local Sustainable Development in the Western Balkans

February 2009 - December 2011

On this project, with my team members, we succeeded to promote a comprehensive and integrated approach to biodiversity and ecosystem services for the sustainable development of rural municipalities and their local communities in Southeastern Europe, as part of an effort to reduce the downward spiral of poverty, biodiversity loss and environmental degradation to increase overall human well-being within the wider context of ensuring regional peace and stability. I edited development of Local Biodiversity Action Planning (LBAP) methodology.

Structure and dynamics of aquatic ecosystems of different trophic levels

January 1996 - December 2000

As a research team member, I contributed to hydrobiological (limnological) research of Vlasina reservoir (Serbia). My research was focused on floristical composition of algae and seasonal and spatial dynamics of phytoplankton in Vlasina reservoir.
